summary: Metalink/HTTP puts download mirror locations, peer-to-peer sources, cryptographic hashes, and signatures in HTTP header fields. These are normally in an XML Metalink file. Download tools can use this to pick mirrors and verify files.

eli5.summary: When you download a file, the server can also say where else you can get it and give a fingerprint to check it. This puts that information in the reply headers.

questions: how to specify mirrors and hashes in http
